#define __VF_BINARY_OP(OP_NAME, TYPE1, TYPE2, NUM)                             \
  template <class T = __cce_simd::Mode_Unknown_Type>                           \
  CCE_INTRINSIC void OP_NAME(vector_##TYPE1 &dst, vector_##TYPE1 src0,         \
                             vector_##TYPE2 src1, vector_bool mask,            \
                             T mode = __cce_simd::MODE_UNKNOWN) {              \
    static_assert(mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_ZEROING.value |               \
                      mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_UNKNOWN.value |           \
                      mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_MERGING.value,            \
                  INVALID_VALUE_PREDICATE_MODE);                               \
    static_assert(                                                             \
        !(mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_ZEROING.value && isV210Target()),     \
        INVALID_VALUE_V210_MODE);                                              \
    if (isV920Target()) {                                                      \
      vector_##TYPE1 dstTmp =                                                  \
          __builtin_cce_##OP_NAME##_##NUM##TYPE1##_x(src0, src1, mask);        \
      dst = (mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_MERGING.value)                     \
                ? __builtin_cce_vsel_##NUM##TYPE1(dstTmp, dst, mask)           \
                : dstTmp;                                                      \
    } else if (isSoftwareMergeMode()) {                                        \
      vector_##TYPE1 dstTmp =                                                  \
          __builtin_cce_##OP_NAME##_##NUM##TYPE1##_x(src0, src1, mask);        \
      dst = (mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_MERGING.value)                     \
                ? __builtin_cce_vmov_##NUM##TYPE1##_m(dst, dstTmp, mask)       \
                : dstTmp;                                                      \
    } else {                                                                   \
      dst =                                                                    \
          (mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_MERGING.value)                       \

records.excerpt:
enum avpattern {
  AV_ALL = 0,   // All elements are set to True
  AV_VL1 = 1,   // The lowest element
  AV_VL2 = 2,   // The lowest 2 elements
  AV_VL3 = 3,   // The lowest 3 elements
  AV_VL4 = 4,   // The lowest 4 elements
  AV_VL8 = 5,   // The lowest 8 elements
  AV_VL16 = 6,  // The lowest 16 elements
  AV_VL32 = 7,  // The lowest 32 elements
  AV_VL64 = 8,  // The lowest 64 elements
  AV_VL128 = 9, // The lowest 128 elements
  AV_MUL3 = 10, // Multiples of 3
  AV_MUL4 = 11, // Multiples of 4
  AV_LOWH = 12, // The lowest half elements
  AV_LOWQ = 13, // The lowest quarter elements
  AV_ALLF = 15  // All elements are set to False
};

template <class T>
CCE_INTRINSIC void dhistv2(vector_u16 &dst, vector_u8 src, vector_bool mask,
                           T bin) {
  static_assert(std::is_class<T>::value, "The 4th argument is not valid.");
  static_assert(
      std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N0_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N1_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N2_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N3_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N4_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N5_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N6_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N7_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N8_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N9_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N10_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N11_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N12_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N13_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N14_Type>::value ||
          std::is_same<T, __cce_simd::Bin_N15_Type>::value,
      "The 4th argument can only be Bin_N0, Bin_N1, "
      "Bin_N2, Bin_N3, Bin_N4, Bin_N5, Bin_N6, Bin_N7, Bin_N8, Bin_N9, "
      "Bin_N10, Bin_N11, Bin_N12, Bin_N13, Bin_N14, Bin_N15.");
  dst = __builtin_cce_dhistv2_m(dst, src, mask, (ULL)bin.value);
  return;
}

records.excerpt:
template <typename DATA_TYPE>
CCE_INTRINSIC[aicore] void
fix_cbuf_to_cbuf(__cbuf__ DATA_TYPE *dst_addr, __cbuf__ DATA_TYPE *src_addr,
                 uint16_t loop3_size, uint16_t loop2_size,
                 uint32_t loop2_dst_stride, uint16_t loop3_src_stride,
                 uint16_t loopi_src_stride, fixp_trans_mode_t trans_mode) {
  static_assert(
      sizeof(DATA_TYPE) == 1 || sizeof(DATA_TYPE) == 2 ||
          sizeof(DATA_TYPE) == 4,
      "The data type of dst and src can only be 8/16/32 bits data type.");
  typedef typename std::conditional<
      sizeof(DATA_TYPE) == 4, int32_t,
      typename std::conditional<sizeof(DATA_TYPE) == 2, int16_t,
                                int8_t>::type>::type BIT_DATA_TYPE;

  CCE_SCALAR(fix_cbuf_to_cbuf_inner)
  (reinterpret_cast<__cbuf__ BIT_DATA_TYPE *>(dst_addr),
   reinterpret_cast<__cbuf__ BIT_DATA_TYPE *>(src_addr), loop3_size, loop2_size,
   loop2_dst_stride, loop3_src_stride, loopi_src_stride,
   static_cast<uint8_t>(trans_mode), 0);
}

#define GROUP_CONV_BT_PT(CCTYPE, CATYPE, CBTYPE)                               \
  template <class DUAL_SRC_LITERAL>                                            \
  CCE_INTRINSIC[aicore] void group_conv(                                       \
      __cc__ CCTYPE *dst, __cbuf__ CATYPE *src0, __cb__ CBTYPE *src1,          \
      uint64_t bt_addr, uint64_t pt_addr, uint64_t config,                     \
      DUAL_SRC_LITERAL dual_src) {                                             \
    static_assert(                                                             \
        std::is_same<DUAL_SRC_LITERAL, DUAL_SRC_DISABLE_TYPE>::value ||        \
            std::is_same<DUAL_SRC_LITERAL, DUAL_SRC_ENABLE_TYPE>::value,       \
        "The para dual_src can only be DUAL_SRC_DISABLE or DUAL_SRC_ENABLE."); \
    uint64_t xd =                                                              \
        ((uint64_t)dst) & 0xffffffffULL | ((bt_addr & 0xffffffffULL) << 32);   \
    uint64_t xn =                                                              \
        ((uint64_t)src0) & 0xffffffffULL | ((pt_addr & 0xffffffffULL) << 32);  \
    if (dual_src.value == DUAL_SRC_DISABLE.value) {                            \
      CCE_SCALAR(group_conv)                                                   \
      ((__cc__ CCTYPE *)xd, (__cbuf__ CATYPE *)xn, src1, config, false);       \
    } else {                                                                   \
      CCE_SCALAR(group_conv)                                                   \
      ((__cc__ CCTYPE *)xd, (__cbuf__ CATYPE *)xn, src1, config, true);        \
    }                                                                          \
  }                                                                            \
                                                                               \
  template <class DUAL_SRC_LITERAL>                                            \
  CCE_INTRINSIC[aicore] void group_conv(                                       \
      __cc__ CCTYPE *dst, __cbuf__ CATYPE *src0, __cb__ CBTYPE *src1,          \
      uint64_t bt_addr, uint64_t pt_addr, uint16_t inW, uint16_t inH,          \
      bool RELU, uint8_t offset, uint8_t addr_SMASK, bool weightOffset,        \
      uint8_t flag, bool cmatrixSource, bool cmatrixInitVal,                   \
      DUAL_SRC_LITERAL dual_src) {                                             \
    static_assert(                                                             \
        std::is_same<DUAL_SRC_LITERAL, DUAL_SRC_DISABLE_TYPE>::value ||        \
            std::is_same<DUAL_SRC_LITERAL, DUAL_SRC_ENABLE_TYPE>::value,       \
        "The para dual_src can only be DUAL_SRC_DISABLE or DUAL_SRC_ENABLE."); \
    uint64_t xd =                                                              \
        ((uint64_t)dst) & 0xffffffffULL | ((bt_addr & 0xffffffffULL) << 32);   \
    uint64_t xn =                                                              \
        ((uint64_t)src0) & 0xffffffffULL | ((pt_addr & 0xffffffffULL) << 32);  \
    if (dual_src.value == DUAL_SRC_DISABLE.value) {                            \
      CCE_SCALAR(group_conv)                                                   \
      ((__cc__ CCTYPE *)xd, (__cbuf__ CATYPE *)xn, src1, inW, inH, RELU,       \
       offset, addr_SMASK, weightOffset, flag, cmatrixSource, cmatrixInitVal,  \
       false);                                                                 \
    } else {                                                                   \
      CCE_SCALAR(group_conv)                                                   \
      ((__cc__ CCTYPE *)xd, (__cbuf__ CATYPE *)xn, src1, inW, inH, RELU,       \
       offset, addr_SMASK, weightOffset, flag, cmatrixSource, cmatrixInitVal,  \
       true);                                                                  \
    }                                                                          \
  }

template <::pipe_t p> CCE_INTRINSIC[aicore] void mark_stamp_check_pipe() {
#if (defined __DAV_VEC__) && (defined __DAV_CUBE__)
    static_assert(p == PIPE_S || p == PIPE_M || p == PIPE_V || p == PIPE_MTE1 ||
                  p == PIPE_MTE2 || p == PIPE_MTE3 ||
                  p == PIPE_FIX); // pipe in [S, M, V, MTE1, MTE2, MTE3, FIX]
#elif (defined __DAV_VEC__)
    static_assert(p == PIPE_S || p == PIPE_MTE2 || p == PIPE_V ||
                  p == PIPE_MTE3); // pipe in [S, V, MTE2, MTE3]
#elif (defined __DAV_CUBE__)
    static_assert(p == PIPE_S || p == PIPE_M || p == PIPE_MTE1 ||
                  p == PIPE_MTE2 || p == PIPE_MTE3 ||
                  p == PIPE_FIX); // pipe in [S, M, MTE1, MTE2, MTE3, FIX]
#endif
  }

enum class ST_L2CacheType : uint32_t {
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NORMAL_FV = 0,    // normal first victim
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NORMAL_LV = 1,    // normal last victim
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NORMAL_PERS = 2,  // normal persistent
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NORMAL_RED = 3,   // normal reduce
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NOTALLOC_CI = 4,  // not-alloc clean-invalid
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NOTALLOC_PW = 5,  // not-alloc clean pre-writeback
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NOTALLOC_PI = 6,  // not-alloc pre-invalid
  L2_CACHE_HINT_NOTALLOC_RED = 7, // not-alloc reduce
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WBH_FV = 8,       // write-back-home first victim
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WBH_LV = 9,       // write-back-home last victim
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WBH_PERS = 10,    // write-back-home persistent
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WBH_RED = 11,     // write-back-home reduce
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WTS_FV = 12,      // write-through-share first victim
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WTS_LV = 13,      // write-through-share last victim
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WTS_PERS = 14,    // write-through-share persistent
  L2_CACHE_HINT_WTS_RED = 15,     // write-through-share reduce
  L2_CACHE_HINT_INVALID = 16,
};

  template <class T1, class T2 = __cce_simd::Mode_Unknown_Type>                \
  CCE_INTRINSIC void vcvt(vector_##TO &dst, vector_##FROM src, T1 pp,          \
                          T2 mode = __cce_simd::MODE_UNKNOWN) {                \
    static_assert(std::is_class<T1>::value, "the 3rd argument is not valid");  \
    static_assert(std::is_same<T1, __cce_simd::PartP0Type>::value ||           \
                      std::is_same<T1, __cce_simd::PartP1Type>::value ||       \
                      std::is_same<T1, __cce_simd::PartP2Type>::value ||       \
                      std::is_same<T1, __cce_simd::PartP3Type>::value,         \
                  "The 3rd argument of this vcvt (" #FROM "2" #TO              \
                  ") can only be: PART_P0, PART_P1, PART_P2, PART_P3");        \
    vector_bool mask1 = pset_b32(__cce_simd::PAT_ALL);                         \
    if (mode.value == __cce_simd::MODE_MERGING.value) {                        \
      vector_bool mask;                                                        \
      if (pp.value == Part_T::P0) {                                            \
        mask = pset_b8(__cce_simd::PAT_M4);                                    \
      } else if (pp.value == Part_T::P1) {                                     \
        vector_bool maskM4Src0 = pset_b8(__cce_simd::PAT_M4);                  \
        vector_bool maskM4Src1 = pset_b8(__cce_simd::PAT_M4);                  \
        mask = __builtin_cce_pslide_b8(maskM4Src0, maskM4Src1, 3);             \
      } else if (pp.value == Part_T::P2) {                                     \
        vector_bool maskAllSrc = pset_b8(__cce_simd::PAT_ALL);                 \
        vector_bool maskAllfSrc = pset_b8(__cce_simd::PAT_ALLF);               \
        vector_boolx2_t __retPintlv;                                           \
        __builtin_cce_pintlv_b8(&__retPintlv, maskAllfSrc, maskAllSrc);        \
        vector_bool maskM2Src = __retPintlv.val[0];                            \
        __builtin_cce_pintlv_b8(&__retPintlv, maskM2Src, maskAllfSrc);         \
        mask = __retPintlv.val[0];                                             \
      } else if (pp.value == Part_T::P3) {                                     \
